content.value_statement: Referral programs need clear incentives, timing, tracking, and fraud controls. This skill helps plan programs, compare structures, model ROI, and improve referral performance.
actual_capabilities: Compares customer referral, affiliate, and hybrid program models.
Designs incentive structures using LTV, gross margin, and target CAC.
Provides referral loop, viral coefficient, referral rate, and ROI formulas.
Recommends launch checklists, dashboard metrics, and cohort analysis questions.
Drafts referral launch, nurture, re-engagement, and affiliate outreach messages.
Identifies common referral fraud patterns and prevention controls.
limitations: Does not connect to referral platforms or customer databases by itself.
Does not verify current pricing or feature availability for listed tools.
Requires user-provided LTV, CAC, margin, and conversion data for precise modeling.
Does not provide legal review for affiliate terms or incentive compliance.

use_cases.title: Launch a Customer Referral Program
use_cases.description: Plan trigger moments, double-sided rewards, launch emails, and dashboard metrics for a new refer-a-friend program.

use_cases.title: Design an Affiliate Partner Offer
use_cases.description: Choose commission structures, cookie duration, partner enablement materials, and outreach copy for creators or agencies.

use_cases.title: Improve Referral Performance
use_cases.description: Diagnose low referral rates, weak conversion, poor incentive fit, and fraud risks with focused optimization tests.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Program Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me design a customer referral program. My product is [product], LTV is [amount], CAC is [amount], and budget is [amount].

prompt_templates.title: Compare Incentive Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare cash, product credit, free months, and tiered rewards for my [B2B or B2C] product. Recommend the best structure and explain tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Audit an Existing Program
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit my referral program. Current referral rate is [rate], conversion is [rate], reward is [reward], and fraud concerns are [concerns].

prompt_templates.title: Model Growth and ROI
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a referral growth model using [customers], [invites per customer], [conversion rate], [reward cost], [margin], and [LTV]. Include risks and tests.

output_examples.input: I need a referral program for a subscription SaaS with $900 LTV and $250 CAC.
output: Recommended structure: double-sided product credit with a reward ceiling below contribution margin.
Launch plan: trigger prompts after activation milestones and renewal moments.
Measurement plan: track referral rate, conversion rate, reward cost, CAC via referral, and referred customer LTV.

output_examples.input: Our affiliate program gets clicks but few qualified demos.
output: Likely issue: partner audience fit, landing page mismatch, or weak qualification criteria.
Recommended tests: update partner briefs, improve referred landing pages, and compare demo incentives against sale-based commissions.
Fraud control: delay payouts until qualified opportunity or activation thresholds are met.

output_examples.input: We want to prevent self-referrals before launch.
output: Add email verification, device checks, payout delays, reward caps, and manual review for suspicious referral clusters.
Define terms that prohibit self-referrals, coupon site abuse, and referral rings.

best_practices: Ask for LTV, CAC, gross margin, product type, and current referral data before recommending rewards.
Use double-sided incentives when the referred customer needs a clear reason to act.
Measure referral quality with referred customer LTV, churn, activation, and repeat referral behavior.
anti_patterns: Do not launch a large cash reward without fraud controls and payout delays.
Do not copy another company's reward size without checking margin and payback period.
Do not optimize referral volume alone when referred customer quality is low.

faq.question: Can this skill design both referral and affiliate programs?
faq.answer: Yes. It compares customer referral, affiliate, and hybrid models, then recommends structures based on goals and economics.

faq.question: What inputs improve the recommendations?
faq.answer: Provide product type, LTV, CAC, gross margin, budget, current referral rate, conversion rate, and available tools.

faq.question: Does it calculate referral ROI?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses revenue from referred customers, rewards, tool costs, and management time to frame ROI.

faq.question: Can it write outreach and launch messages?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes affiliate outreach, referral launch, nurture, and re-engagement message templates.

faq.question: Does it include fraud prevention guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers self-referrals, referral rings, coupon code abuse, fake emails, VPN use, and payout controls.

faq.question: Does it integrate with referral tools?
faq.answer: No. It helps choose and plan tools, but it does not connect to external platforms or customer data.
